evidenceOrigin: Fresh targeted recovery run. Original /tmp evidence no longer exists. Historical PASS counts below are conversation checkpoints, not reconstructed logs.

previousCheckpoint.productionLocal: 6/6 rooms passed: full lifecycle plus simultaneous answers 3x, duplicate/disconnect, host offline/rejoin
previousCheckpoint.controlledDev: 2/2 stale Host reproductions with 500ms delayed leave

freshChecks.controlledBrowser: 1/1 reproduced with native WebSocket/polling observation, 1 Teacher and 2 independent Students
freshChecks.protocolOnly: 1/1 reproduced with real Socket.IO client and no React
freshChecks.fault: 500ms delay in test-only Socket.IO middleware for old leave; no application source changes
freshChecks.database: Temporary loopback PostgreSQL 16; existing migrations; synthetic users only
freshChecks.server: Existing createApp/createRealtime modules, unmodified authorization and quiz service; extra observation and test-only delayed middleware completion

confirmedMechanism: QuizRoom effect cleanup emits leave even before initial connection; Socket.IO buffers it. StrictMode development effect re-setup reuses the socket and emits join on connect.
Incoming leave and join each pass asynchronous authorization. Existing room/user transition queue begins in event handlers, after middleware; it serializes handler arrival, not packet arrival.

A newer join can complete and ACK before the older leave enters the transition queue. The older leave removes quiz-room membership on that same socket; transport stays connected and UI membership stays joined.

Host start returns a fresh command ACK despite lost subscription. Answer transactions and reveal persist correctly. Broadcast enumerates quiz-room members, omits the Host; React cannot apply an event it never receives.

Reload opens a different socket and restores state and room membership. A leave on an old different socket cannot directly delete the new socket membership; protocol-only test confirmed the other Host socket remains subscribed.
Explicit leave currently leaves the unused quiz-host adapter room behind until disconnect; quiz-room is the broadcast target. This does not mean Host is still subscribed to quiz-state.
limits: Controlled delays prove scheduling susceptibility, not natural reproduction probability.
Fresh trace does not establish the cause of the original 16 October audit.
Normal production bundle PASS does not disprove server ordering weakness; controlled FAIL does not prove hosted staging FAIL.
Fresh run only reconstructs missing race evidence; production build and previously passing suites were not rerun.

proposedMinimalFix.change: Remove explicit quiz:room:leave from effect teardown; remove listeners and disconnect the component-owned socket. Existing server disconnect path handles real departure, including join interrupted by disconnect. Do not merely condition leave on socket.connected.

In bind(), register a per-socket FIFO gate for quiz:room:join/leave before existing asynchronous authorization middleware (quiz.bind currently executes before socket.use in server.ts). Hold each gate until the full membership operation settles, including validation/auth/error paths. Keep existing per-room/user transition queue for cross-socket coordination. Clear queued work on disconnect and retain socket.connected guard. Legitimate leave removes both quiz-room and quiz-host memberships.

fixConstraints: No new public event fields or API error contracts, DB schema, infrastructure, scoring, timer, UI design, RBAC or authorization decisions.
Server queue must preserve ingress order through async middleware AND DB work; serializing handlers alone or releasing immediately after next() is insufficient.
Reject/cancel queued work on disconnect; release gate in finally for operation errors and on authorization-triggered disconnect. Do not make all leave events no-ops.

cases: Deterministically delay old leave middleware while newer join arrives on the same socket; final membership must reflect leave then join, and reveal must reach Host without reload.
Inverse sequence join then legitimate leave ends offline; duplicate join/leave is idempotent; one participant row per student.
Host and Student reconnect on new sockets; old socket leave/disconnect does not remove new membership; two tabs keep presence online until last disconnect.
Disconnect during queued/in-flight join, validation errors, and authorization-triggered disconnect release queues and create no ghost presence.
StrictMode setup/cleanup/setup sends no obsolete explicit leave; cleanup disconnects owned socket; obsolete ACK ignored.
Three independent contexts: lobby, activation, both answers, server reveal observed on Host without reload; correlate DB, Socket.IO receive, React and UI.
Student disconnect after submit restores ownAnswer without extra answer/participant; Host reconnect during question and offline during reveal recovers deadline and latest state.
Run targeted regression on dev StrictMode and production build; preserve existing timer, scoring and lost-ACK checks.

traceTimeUnit: Milliseconds from start of fresh probe; browser receipt timestamps are observation completion times, not exact network arrival times.
cleanup: Probe API/browser closed; temporary Vite and PostgreSQL stopped; ports 3000/5173/55439 verified free; task-owned /tmp/examspace-race-resume removed.
